confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant, cafe, and bar anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence because Melbourne CBD rates vary with events and weekday/weekend demand. Beer, cocktail, and wine anchors are based on direct knowledge of local pricing. The FX observation (15 Oct 2026, 0.6955) came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange rates page and was not opened directly. A 16 Oct figure from a third-party site was not used because it is not confirmed as an RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Australian capital-city pricing, benchmarked against Sydney-level costs and adjusted for Melbourne's cafe and bar culture. Accommodation anchors reflect CBD and inner-city visitor areas. No single foreign comparable city was used.
